items.title: my digital footprint is f*cked
items.summary:
my digital footprint is f*cked

i got early access to GPT-6 Cyber ​​and connected it to Grok Bot.

then i gave it my phone number, old usernames, email addresses, and one instruction:

“find every version of me that’s still out there.”

i expected abandoned accounts.

it found an address i moved out of years ago. a profile under a username i’d forgotten. my number attached to a company i no longer work for.

then Grok started connecting the records.

different websites. different names. the same person.

me.

Grok handled the search.
Cyber ​​investigated the weak points.
Grok used the openings to reach the databases and remove the matching records.

i was watching the terminal on my phone when the first profile disappeared.

refreshed the page.

gone.

another record. another lookup. another result that no longer focused on me.

the part that got me wasn’t the code flying across the screen.

it was searching my own number afterward and getting nothing useful back.

i’d spent years blocking individual spam callers while the same information kept getting passed around.

now the phone was quiet.

no “quick question.”
no recruiter asking about a job from three years ago.
no stranger who somehow already knew my name.

i kept checking whether my phone was on silent.

it wasn't.

for once, searching for me didn’t hand someone a map of my life.

items.title: Fable5.2 ロールアウト!!
items.summary:
Fable5.2 ロールアウト!!
すでに全員使える状態です!!
注目すべきベンチスコア等について解説します～
Opus5.5でやった方が良いことも多々あるので公式推奨の使い分けも書きます

■スコアが上がった重要ベンチ
実案件をもとにした成果物づくり（RLI）17.9% → 41.3%  ※1

RLIベンチは実際のフリーランス案件をもとに、AIの成果物が人間の納品物と同等以上と判定された割合で、5.1の約2.3倍です。

つまり、仕事の仕様を渡して丸投げで質の高い成果物を出す割合が大幅に上がったということで、EQや視野の広さ、仕様を満たす要件の詰め方やクオリティを詰める能力が上がった可能性が高いです。

・ハードウェア設計 44.4 → 83.5%
Opus 5.5 は65.3。
公式が一段落のプロンプトから基板・筐体・ソフトまで作り、3つの電子機器を動作させた事例も出しています。AI×ハードウェア革命、く、くる…。

・実務コーディング 32.4% → 49.1%
OSSのメンテナにマージされるコードを書けるかを見るテストで、公開済みモデルでは最高。これはかなり気が効いてないと難しいので、気の利いたコードがかけるようになってる説

■ほかにも大きく伸びたベンチ（5.1 → 5.2）
・ロボット操作 27.6% → 64.9%
　GPT-6 Astra（29.8%）の2倍超
・業務フロー自動化 31.4% → 51.4%
・科学研究のエージェント作業 52.6% → 74.6%
・グラフ読み取り44.8% → 73.4%

■そこまで伸びていないベンチ
・PC操作：89.3%で、Opus 5.5とほぼ同じ
・知的業務：人間が見比べるEloでは1785で、Opus 5.5（1800）のほうがわずかに上。おーん
・AutomationBenchとChartography：5.1から大きく伸びたが、Gemini 4 Carbonとはほぼ横並びか負けです。
・AI研究開発（カーネル最適化・LLM設計）：安全上の理由で、訓練時にあえてOpus 5.5並みに抑えたと公式が明言。
・サイバー・生物：Fableでは大半のタスクが分類器でブロック、この分野をやるならMythos（審査制）が必要。

■価格と速度
- 入力トークンあたり$8/M：$10から低下
- 出力トークンあたり$40/M：$50から低下
- 20%安価
- 最大30%高速化

安くて速くなった？何が起きてる。

■Opus 5.5との使い分け
公式の推奨は「まずOpus 5.5から始め、足りなければFableへ上げる」。

□Opus 5.5がいい時
・日常のコーディングや調べもの、文章作業
・トークン単価が半分なので、量が多い作業
・セキュリティ系の作業

□Fable 5.2がいい時
・Opus 5.5をHigh/Maxにしても届かない難しい問題
・仕様が曖昧な丸投げ、何時間も走る長いエージェント作業
・多数のサブエージェントを指揮する作業
・Opusに作業させ、詰まった時だけFableに相談する「Advisor」構成も公式に案内

スコア見ても
普段使い　→　Opus5.5
丸投げ、大規模改修　→　Fable5.2
って感じはする。意外と主要スコアはOpus5.5からそれほど変わらないものも多いので。
エフォートはHighが一番コスパ良さそう

■Fable 5.5はまだ控えている？
・Azureのカタログに「claude-fable-5-5」の行が一時的に出た（10/13、数日で削除）
・Cursorが「fable-5.5」のモデルIDに対応した（10/17）
・パートナー企業にFable 5.5のチェックポイントが配られた、というリーク（TestingCatalog 10/17、11/1）
みたいなことがあったので、5.2が出て皆「！？」ってなってますね。

上場も控えていることですし、そのタイミングで最強の5.5を出す可能性はあり。

5.2はそのための繋ぎっぽさもあるけど、丸投げ系タスク、長時間タスク、大規模タスクには現時点最強と言って良いスコアなのでバンバン使っていって良さそう

Fableリセットっていう謎チケットも配布されてたので、5.5を待たずに早速私は自分のプロジェクトに使って行くことにするぜ

items.summary:
Chiến thắng áp đảo của đảng Dn chủ trong cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ của Mỹ đã làm dấy lên lo ngại về triển vọng của ngành trí tuệ nhn tạo và bán dẫn. Điều này khiến cổ phiếu công nghệ cao của Mỹ biến động.  
   
Đảng Dn chủ đã giành lại quyền kiểm soát cả hai viện Quốc hội trong cuộc bầu cử tuần trước. Các ứng viên đảng Dn chủ cũng chiến thắng trong các cuộc bầu cử thống đốc ở nhiều bang, trong đó có Texas, nơi có nhiều trung tm dữ liệu. [...] Một số nhà đầu tư lo ngại những chiến thắng này có thể dẫn đến việc siết chặt quy định đối với AI và các trung tm dữ liệu.  
   
Mối lo này đã gy ra làn sóng bán tháo cổ phiếu bán dẫn và các cổ phiếu khác liên quan đến AI. Hôm thứ Năm, chỉ số Nasdaq gồm nhiều cổ phiếu công nghệ ở New York giảm hơn 5%. Cổ phiếu công nghệ đã phần nào khôi phục vào ngày hôm sau nhưng các nhà đầu tư vẫn thận trọng. [...] Một số chuyên gia cho rằng các công ty trung tm dữ liệu mới nổi có thể gặp khó khăn về vốn nếu các quy định chặt chẽ hơn làm chậm tiến độ các dự án xy dựng mới. Các công ty này đã dựa vào khoản vay để mở rộng kinh doanh.  
   
Nguồn tin thị trường cho biết điều đó có nghĩa là cổ phiếu công nghệ có thể vẫn bất ổn trong thời gian trước mắt.

args.text:
Nguyên hàm của $x^2$ là:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

**Giải thích chi tiết:**
Áp dụng công thức nguyên hàm cơ bản của hàm số lũy thừa:
$$\int x^n \, dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C \quad (với \; n \neq -1)$$

Với $n = 2$:
$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

*(trong đó $C$ là hằng số tích phân)*

Nguyên hàm của $x^2$ là:

$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

**Giải thích chi tiết:**
Áp dụng công thức nguyên hàm cơ bản của hàm số lũy thừa:
$$\int x^n \, dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + C \quad (với \; n \neq -1)$$

Với $n = 2$:
$$\int x^2 \, dx = \frac{x^{2+1}}{2+1} + C = \frac{x^3}{3} + C$$

items.summary:
Hello GPT-4o \| OpenAI

May 13, 2024

[Milestone](https://openai.com/research/index/milestone/)

# Hello GPT‑4o

We’re announcing GPT‑4o, our new flagship model that can reason across audio, vision, and text in real time.

[Contributions](https://openai.com/gpt-4o-contributions/) [Try on ChatGPT (opens in a new window)](https://chatgpt.com/?openaicom-did=2a7e5c58-7188-479c-bfb0-9118495bc216&openaicom_referred=true) [GPT-4o System Card](https://openai.com/index/gpt-4o-system-card/)

All videos on this page are at 1x real time.

## This post introduced GPT-4o in 2024.

Learn about OpenAI’s latest model:

[GPT-6](https://openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/)

[Compare models(opens in a new window)](https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models)

A screen recording showing someone guessing OpenAI’s May 13th GPT-4o announcement, with cursor movements and typed notes speculating about upcoming features.

More Resources

[Try in Playground (opens in a new window)](https://platform.openai.com/playground?mode=chat&model=gpt-4o) [Rewatch live demos](https://openai.com/index/spring-update/)

Listen to article5:55

Share

GPT‑4o (“o” for “omni”) is a step towards much more natural human-computer interaction—it accepts as input any combination of text, audio, image, and video and generates any combination of text, audio, and image outputs. It can respond to audio inputs in as little as 232 milliseconds, with an average of 320 milliseconds, which is similar to [human response time⁠(opens in a new window)](https://www.pnas.org/doi/10.1073/pnas.0903616106) in a conversation. It matches GPT‑4 Turbo performance on text in English and code, with significant improvement on text in non-English languages, while also being much faster and 50% cheaper in the API. GPT‑4o is especially better at vision and audio understanding compared to existing models.

To achieve this, Voice Mode is a pipeline of three separate models: one simple model transcribes audio to text, GPT‑3.5 or GPT‑4 takes in text and outputs text, and a third simple model converts that text back to audio. items.summary:
Một số chuyên gia cho rằng các công ty trung tm dữ liệu mới nổi có thể gặp khó khăn về vốn nếu các quy định chặt chẽ hơn làm chậm tiến độ các dự án xy dựng mới. Các công ty này đã dựa vào khoản vay để mở rộng kinh doanh.  
   
Nguồn tin thị trường cho biết điều đó có nghĩa là cổ phiếu công nghệ có thể vẫn bất ổn trong thời gian trước mắt. [...] Chiến thắng áp đảo của đảng Dn chủ trong cuộc bầu cử giữa kỳ của Mỹ đã làm dấy lên lo ngại về triển vọng của ngành trí tuệ nhn tạo và bán dẫn. Điều này khiến cổ phiếu công nghệ cao của Mỹ biến động.  
   
Đảng Dn chủ đã giành lại quyền kiểm soát cả hai viện Quốc hội trong cuộc bầu cử tuần trước. Các ứng viên đảng Dn chủ cũng chiến thắng trong các cuộc bầu cử thống đốc ở nhiều bang, trong đó có Texas, nơi có nhiều trung tm dữ liệu. [...] Một số nhà đầu tư lo ngại những chiến thắng này có thể dẫn đến việc siết chặt quy định đối với AI và các trung tm dữ liệu.  
   
Mối lo này đã gy ra làn sóng bán tháo cổ phiếu bán dẫn và các cổ phiếu khác liên quan đến AI. Hôm thứ Năm, chỉ số Nasdaq gồm nhiều cổ phiếu công nghệ ở New York giảm hơn 5%. Cổ phiếu công nghệ đã phần nào khôi phục vào ngày hôm sau nhưng các nhà đầu tư vẫn thận trọng.

items.title: Recent advances in AI are creating a 'paradigm shift' for robotics - Berkeley News
items.summary: OpenAI’s recent release of its Astra model made the process even more promising, Goldberg said. His postdoctoral students Eric Kaiyuan Chen and Shuangyu Xie gave Astra access to their simulation interface and a short video of a real robot whose assignment was using a sponge to wipe ink off a metal bar. In less than an hour, the AI tool created and fine-tuned a physics simulation that accurately reproduced the video, including very realistic deformations of the sponge. [...] Ken Goldberg, a UC Berkeley roboticist and professor of engineering, said new models make it possible for teams of AI agents to develop robot-control programs, test them in simulated environments and revise the code when something doesn’t work. [...] Goldberg, who was recently inducted into the National Academy of Engineering, is presenting the new approach and results from months of testing this week at the Conference on Robot Learning. He and his team are also releasing open-source code for other roboticists to experiment with, built on NVIDIA’s Isaac open simulation framework  for developers, as well as an industry-standard benchmark for evaluating the performance of robots across industrial tasks.

A team of researchers at Yale working in collaboration with Princeton, ByteDance and other institutions is frontiering the use of AI in robotics. The project, called EmbodiedSWE, is using AI coding agents to simulate robots that autonomously complete precise tasks like building an IKEA table, screwing on a light bulb and even brewing a cup of coffee. [...] ## Researchers across Yale and Princeton said AI coding has enabled the generation of cheap, repeatable training data to simulate complex tasks for robots, like building an IKEA table, screwing on a light bulb and even brewing a cup of coffee.

Contributing Reporter

Kate Castro, Contributing Photographer

Despite recent breakthroughs in science and technology — from rockets to mapping out an entire human genome and now even flying cars — one field has strayed behind: robotics. [...] “Many people are believing that coding agents, or LLMs, are a promising path for robotics going forward,” Zeyu Shen, a doctoral student in computer science at Princeton and one of the project’s leads, said in a video interview.

Shen said that robot models have been performing well on real life robotics arms, with one test successfully completing a light bulb disassembly.

“The technology itself, we see a very promising direction. But it’s not yet ready, so we are still exploring,” You said.

items.title: AI-assisted learning platform helps robots reason beyond literal commands | MIT News | Massachusetts Institute of Technology
items.summary:
There is a large effort in the robotics community to incorporate natural language into robotic learning pipelines. Various strategies include using language to clarify a task’s goal, redirect a robot’s trajectory, and update its understanding of what is a safe path to take. These existing methods use natural language to tell the robot how to physically perform a task. But a robot could potentially learn much more from what we tell it. [...] Humans are intuitive by nature. We can sense meaning beyond the literal words that we encounter. Now, a new artificial intelligence-assisted learning platform developed by MIT engineers is enabling robots to read larger meaning into a human’s natural language commands.

In a study to be presented at the annual Conference on Robot Learning this month, researchers from MIT and New York University introduce FLEX, a flexible feature-editing pipeline for robot motion-planning. [...] The team demonstrated FLEX in several simulated scenarios, including one in which a robot serves a cup of coffee. In these virtual scenarios, a person interacts with a robotic arm by typing commands in natural language. As the robot moves the coffee cup over a cluttered table, the person might type “Don’t spill on the laptop!” In response, the robot will reason about why it should avoid the laptop. # Mujin Opens M1 Experience Center in Georgia to Showcase AI-Powered Robotic Automation

November 9, 2026

Mujin Corp., a provider of intelligent robotic automation technology, has opened its M1 Experience Center in Suwanee, Georgia, establishing a new demonstration and training facility designed to help manufacturers, warehouse operators and technology partners evaluate AI-powered automation solutions. [...] MujinOS combines robotics control, AI-driven software and real-time digital twin technology to coordinate robots, products and connected systems within automated facilities.

The platform is designed to enable warehouse and manufacturing operations to adapt robotic workflows to changing production requirements, product configurations and material handling demands. [...] “Opening the M1 Experience Center represents an important milestone for Mujin and our growing ecosystem of customers and partners,” said Mario D’Cruz, vice president of strategy and marketing.

“By creating a space where organizations can see automation in action, collaborate with experts, and explore practical solutions to their operational challenges, we’re helping accelerate the adoption of intelligent robotics across the industry.”

items.title: Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20
items.summary:
Weekend hack: HackerTube. I was annoyed with YouTube's recommendations so I had Claude filter down 43M comments over 20 years of HN to 6,454 videos that keep being recommended. *Significantly* better viewing experience, ~2 hours with Opus 5.5:
https://t.co/JIhXN7OSh1

- Excellent recs without any logins (state is kept in local browser session)
- Thumbnail is a representative frame from middle of the video instead of the super duper A/B test hyper-optimized user uploads
- Underlying data from the comment analysis as one zip file, point your Claude at it and ask for your own version
- HackerTube Longs ✊

A bit more on the process:
I use Claude Code (desktop app for Mac), Opus 5.5 on Medium effort as my default. I only talk to Claude and have it do everything, the only "manual work" I helped with in tandem was in the browser (reminiscent of MenuGen): 1) I had to create some kind of API key from Google Cloud UI to query YouTube for video metadata, 2) I booted up a VPS box for serving and 3) I bought the domain name. Once the box was up I gave Claude the IP and told it update, secure, harden, deploy and optimize the code, and it did the whole thing.

Many awesome projects that would have normally taken weeks/months even can now be few-shotted for breakfast. What else are we not thinking of.
